title: MuLD: The Multitask Long Document Benchmark
reasoning: The paper introduces a technical benchmark for evaluating Natural Language Processing models on long documents. The tasks and datasets (e.g., NarrativeQA, HotpotQA, Open Subtitles) are focused on language understanding capabilities like question answering, summarization, and translation, with no component dedicated to evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics.
